title: Create
description: Brief, scenes, assets, generation, review, and export share one autosaved project context.

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: Define the production goal and create a local, zero-cost plan.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.description: Review the scene breakdown, shot intent, camera, and timing.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Attach references and verify every required local asset before approval.

generate.title: Generate
generate.description: Inspect the model decision, approve a maximum cost, then submit paid work.

review.title: Review
review.description: Compare takes side by side, record notes, and keep, reject, or revise.

export.title: Export
export.description: Package accepted work, provenance, and handoff material.

labels.ideaHelp: Saved locally. Creating a plan does not call a provider or spend API credits.
labels.approvalRule: One submission and one review per selected shot. Retakes need new approval.
labels.semanticReview: Use approved Gemini semantic review when reviewing a take

empty.title: Create the first production run
empty.description: Create uses the current prompt, scene pack, assets, and storyboard. This planning step is local and cannot spend API credits.
